Purpose of this report

Against that background, the World Bank has been asked to review current trends

in health expenditure in the context of the broader fiscal situation facing Vanuatu, and to

identify health-financing options that meet development goals in ways that are financially

affordable and sustainable. This process involved a series of missions to Vanuatu during 2012
